text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To think you skipped a grade to get in... Flower, they really
recognized your talent! My heart is still pounding!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
We'll always be cheering you on, no matter what.
If you ever need anything at all, just let us know right away!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Thank you, Mom, Dad... And thank you,
Tracen Academy, for believing in me...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: This is where I'll make my dreams come true...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Another splendid run of Bakushin power today!
Behold the stride of an honor student! And yet, something is missing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Mmm?! You there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What say you to breaking a sweat with me? Nay, let us run!
As fellow horsegirls studying at Tracen Academy!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, run together... with you?
Y-Yes! It's nice to meet you!
My, this looks like fun.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely, refreshing morning.
Would you mind if we all ran together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
! Oho, a challenge, is it?! Splendid!
Whenever a gauntlet is thrown, I shall answer the call!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
With the upperclassmen...?
Y-Yes! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Today's breeze is sure to carry the fragrance of blossoms.
Hehe, let us enjoy this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HA HA HA! I'm just getting started...!
Take THIIIIIS!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not so fast.
Now then, be mindful of the gusting wind...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Guh, hah, hah... hah...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(—I can't keep up. It hurts. I can't catch my breath.
The sound of their horseshoes is fading into the distance...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Why... can't I... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(The figures crossing the finish line looked so small...
I could barely even see them.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, as expected of me! Though it turned into quite the close battle at the end,
it was a complete and utter victory! Still, magnificent running from both of you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I thought I reached the line first.
Well, without a judge present, it is difficult to say for certain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! In that case, let us have a rematch!
Next time, I shall claim an undisputed, flawless victory!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Petals dance upon the breeze, so to keep my sight clear,
I must become the wind itself, must I not?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Even after running like that... they've already caught their breath...
They're on a completely different level from me...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(—Time and time again after that, I was reminded of how different we are.
Our physiques... our strength, our experience... I lacked everything.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see. Even if they accepted me... I'm still just a kid.
In that case, I have to... I have to work way harder than I am right now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Looking up, cherry blossoms were blooming high in the sky.
But... my own flowers haven't bloomed yet.)

Today, I headed out to the training track once again in search
of an Umamusume to scout. Then, over in the corner—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Phew... No, that's not quite it.
When Bakushin O-san steps in, she pushes off more like...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're the Trainer from the other day, right?
I'm Nishino Flower. Is your injury all better now?

After thanking her once more for the other day, I asked the question on my mind.
It looked like she was training all by herself, but—
choice_data_list: Why are you over here in the corner?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, the truth is, I still have so much to learn... and, um,
I was worried I might get in everyone's way.
choice_data_list: You'd never be in the way...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay! It's just for now!
I'm going to work as hard as I can from now on so I can catch up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Little by little each day, I'm learning to do things I couldn't do before,
you know? Ehehe.

Nishino Flower gave me a bright smile as she spoke.
Bowing deeply, she returned to her training.

Fully aware of her own inexperience, she continued to pour in effort.
Watching her was inspiring, and it rekindled a fire within my dejected self.
choice_data_list: ...I have to give it my all, too!

text_block_list.text:
Even without a track record, there are still things to learn. None of it is wasted.
When I finally find an Umamusume to train, I'll do everything in my power to support her.
While spending days hitting the library to absorb as much knowledge as possible—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello! Are you here to read too?
Wow, that's a whole lot of difficult-looking books...
choice_data_list: I'm brushing up on my training knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're already a professional Trainer?
That's amazing! You're such a hard worker!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Because of me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, look who it is. Flower.
What's got you in such a great mood, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Sky-san! Hehe, yes!
Something really, really wonderful happened!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Heeh, really?
...No wonder you seem even more...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(That Trainer said... they found courage from watching me.
Ehehe... I'm so happy. I have to work even harder!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just a bit more............!
From here, push even harder—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Flower!
